privileged_info_for_vlm: The source data contains exactly 150 records for Corn, Soybeans, and Winter Wheat. Key thresholds for scoring: pH Low is < 5.5; Phosphorus (P) Low is < 15 ppm, Medium is 15-30, Optimal is > 30; Potassium (K) Low is < 120 ppm, Medium is 120-170, Optimal is > 170.
